name: GL_COA_MAPPINGS
description: GL_COA_MAPPINGS contains the chart of accounts mappings defined in the Chart of Accounts Mappings page.  Each row includes the name, from chart of accounts, to chart of accounts, and description of the mapping. There is a one to many relationship between the chart of accounts mappings stored in this table and the detail mapping information stored in the GL_COA_MAP_ACCOUNT_RULES and GL_COA_MAP_SEGMENT_RULES tables.

columns.name: COA_MAPPING_ID
columns.description: Key flexfield structure instance mapping identifier.

columns.name: TO_COA_ID
columns.description: Target key flexfield structure instance identifier.

columns.name: FROM_COA_ID
columns.description: Source key flexfield structure instance identifier.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: User defined chart of accounts definition name.

columns.name: SECURITY_FLAG
columns.description: Enable definition access set security flag.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
